Joseph Edward Schur
Joseph Edward Schur is a Canadian publisher, creative director, and media professional based in Toronto. He is best known as the founder and publisher of Spencer Magazine, a Canadian luxury lifestyle publication that focuses on fashion, design, culture, travel, and influential personalities. Through his work in print and digital media, Schur has established himself as a figure in Canada’s contemporary lifestyle and creative publishing landscape.
Early life and education
Joseph Edward Schur was born and raised in Canada. From an early age, he demonstrated a strong interest in visual culture, storytelling, and design. His formative years were shaped by exposure to art, fashion, and media, influences that later informed his professional pursuits. While details of his formal education have not been widely publicized, Schur’s career reflects a background grounded in creative disciplines, branding, and editorial development.
Career
Early career
Before founding his own publication, Schur worked across various creative and media-adjacent fields, gaining experience in branding, communications, and visual storytelling. These early professional experiences provided him with insight into editorial production, audience engagement, and the evolving relationship between print and digital media.
Spencer Magazine
Schur is the founder and publisher of Spencer Magazine, a Toronto-based luxury lifestyle magazine launched with the aim of showcasing Canadian and international talent across fashion, design, art, architecture, and culture. Under his leadership, the magazine has featured high-profile creatives, designers, cultural figures, and tastemakers.
As publisher, Schur oversees the magazine’s editorial vision, brand partnerships, and overall creative direction. He has been instrumental in positioning the publication as a platform that blends aspirational lifestyle content with a distinctly Canadian perspective, while maintaining international appeal.
The magazine is known for its seasonal print editions, high-production editorial photography, and curated events, including cover reveal parties and industry gatherings hosted in Toronto and other major cities.
Creative direction and media work
Beyond publishing, Schur is recognized for his role as a creative director and brand collaborator. He has worked closely with photographers, stylists, designers, and media professionals to develop cohesive visual narratives and branded content. His work emphasizes storytelling, aesthetics, and experiential engagement, particularly through live events and editorial campaigns.
Influence and recognition
Schur is often described as a “renaissance man” within Canadian lifestyle media, reflecting his multidisciplinary approach to publishing, design, and creative leadership. His work with Spencer Magazine has contributed to conversations around modern luxury, independent publishing, and the continued relevance of print media in a digital-first era.
Through editorial features and collaborations, Schur has helped spotlight emerging and established creatives, while also fostering partnerships with fashion houses, hospitality brands, and cultural institutions.
Personal life
Joseph Edward Schur is based in Toronto, where he continues to lead Spencer Magazine and pursue creative projects. He is known for maintaining close relationships with family, friends, and collaborators, and for drawing ongoing inspiration from travel, art, and contemporary culture. While he maintains a public professional profile, Schur keeps much of his personal life private.
